zh-CN.title: Niko 与 Fufu 胶囊焕新
items: Niko 放大至气泡上沿原地奔跑，并补齐象牙猫爪场景
Fufu 沿气泡下沿横向奔跑，加入虎斑纹理与扬尘轨迹
两套胶囊完整预告角色在真实聊天气泡中的位置关系

en.title: Refreshed Niko and Fufu capsules
items: Niko is enlarged and runs in place along an ivory paw-print bubble edge
Fufu runs across the lower edge with tabby texture and a dust trail
Both capsules now preview the character-to-bubble relationship used in chat
